description: Return a code-project manifest for an owned world, model, asset pack, material, Image, or video/audio asset. Entries include stable artifactId and semantic role fields plus durable URLs, suggested paths, loader hints, file metadata, and trustworthy Image dimensions or video/audio duration when Mint knows them. Persisted presentation previews use kind asset_preview and role preview_image so viewers can sync a thumbnail without exposing the raw source URL. Worlds return an identified remote_stream RAD runtime plus an identified collider GLB. Requires ownership and final output readiness; unknown metadata is omitted and private provider details are never returned.
name: get_asset_artifact_manifest
title: Get Asset Artifact Manifest
